citationText: 18. A single forensic marking standard would , of course, be highly desirable. The existence of such a standard would greatly simplify recovery and ensure broad deployment. Unfortunately, standardizing a specific marking algorithm would prove difficult, as the algorithm would be exposed to the scrutiny of attackers.
